'''L4E-R5''' was an [[R5 series astromech droid]] who served in the [[Resistance]]. L4E-R5 acted as the [[astromech droid]] of [[Lega Fossang]], placed inside the [[astromech socket]] of her [[BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
